name: Rugged Art RuggedMarket targetedPurchase arbitrary router call
summary: RuggedMarket.targetedPurchase() forwarded attacker-supplied UniversalRouter commands and inputs without validating them, letting a flash-loan-funded caller sweep the market's RUGGED balance and NFTs and then unstake against it.
notes: The second and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected RuggedMarket implementation 0xfe380fe1db07e531e3519b9ae3ea9f7888ce20c6.
The commit-pinned reproduction reports approximately 5 ETH of net proceeds. The USD amount values that reported quantity at DefiLlama's incident-time ETH price.
